notes.title: Release date and UI update!
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone! Today we're going to talk about the news on the game.

[/p][h1]Game Release[/h1][p] We are happy to announce that Brainrot Animals Fighting will be released on July 3 at 13:00 EST! Add the game to your wishlist to get a release notification. [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3337680/Brainrot_Animals_Fighting/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]  [/p][h1]UI redesign[/h1][p]On the game page you can notice updated screenshots of the game with new UI design.
It is more informative: it shows the number of won rounds, the timer until the end of the match and the damage dealt.[/p][p]
